definitions.explanation: A small, soft, cake-like steamed bun, typically lightly sweet and made with wheat flour. Popular as a snack and as homemade food for small children because of its light texture and the fact that it can be made without an oven.

examples.japanese: {蒸|む}しパン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おやつ→おやつ：17921_oyatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{蒸|む}しパン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べている→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: The kids are having steamed bread for a snack.

examples.japanese: ホットケーキミックス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}えば→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{電子|でんし}レンジ→電子レンジ：04973_denshirenji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{蒸|む}しパン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}れる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。

notes:
Compound of ⟦{蒸|む}す→蒸す：02307_musu⟧ (to steam) + ⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧ (bread). The texture is somewhere between a muffin and a sponge cake, lighter and moister than baked bread.
